blast_radius: Files loopqueue proposals; --live, so it does write to the queue.

throughput.derivation: loops.daily_counts()/window_count() over the loopqueue ledger (gitignored; read directly since plain rg skips it without -uu). Only covered days are sampled; absent days are never zero-padded.

floor.reason: insufficient history: only 2 covered days are present in the ledger's retained window

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: feature-health issue filer (03:40/11:40/19:40); volume is loopqueue events authored by actor=feature-health-filer.
why_it_matters: The filer is how failing features become queue work; a live filer that files nothing is consistent with its upstream health suites producing no executed runs to file from.
